Mammal.label: MAMMAL
Mammal.explain: Mammals have hair or fur and feed their young with milk.

Insect.label: INSECT
Insect.explain: Insects have six legs and three body parts: head, thorax and abdomen.

Bird.label: BIRD
Bird.explain: Birds have feathers and a beak, and they lay eggs with hard shells.

Reptile.label: REPTILE
Reptile.explain: Reptiles have dry, scaly skin, and most lay eggs on land.

Amphibian.label: AMPHIBIAN
Amphibian.explain: Amphibians have moist skin and most start life in water, often as tadpoles.
